pendingApprove.title: Approve this account?
pendingApprove.body: You are approving the phone {{phone}} as {{role}}. The account will no longer be pending.

accountDelete.title: Delete this account?
accountDelete.body: You are deleting the account of {{who}}, with the role {{role}}. The account will no longer exist. This cannot be undone.
accountDelete.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is kept with this action.
accountDelete.reasonShort: The reason needs at least 10 characters.

passwordClear.title: Remove the password?
passwordClear.body: You are removing the password from the account of {{who}}. The current password will no longer sign in. No new password is created. Sessions that are already open stay valid.
passwordClear.help: Removes the password from this account. The person can no longer sign in with it. No new password is created. Google sign-in, if any, stays as it is.
passwordClear.unavailable: Only a principal administrator can remove the password. Your session does not include this action.
passwordClear.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is kept with this action.
passwordClear.reasonShort: The reason needs at least 10 characters.
